_doc: Owned by AI-C. 24 collectible scraps hinting at why the Zero Line never reaches its last stop. Fields: id (lore_NN, stable), title (<=40 chars), kind (note|timetable|ticket|graffiti|memo), text (<=280 chars, shown on a parchment card), found_in (car kind: obs|sleep|lp|pass|dine|lug; the car where the scrap can turn up), rarity (common|odd|rare, same words as objects.json), tier (reputation tier 0-4 that unlocks it; must be >= the car's unlock tier: sleep 1, obs 2, lug 3). Canon (do not contradict): the train is made of things people could not let go of; it stops only for those still looking; the little front door is tagged 'unclaimed'; a lantern with a blank ticket waits behind it; handing things back makes the train lighter; the last stop is a handing-over, not a place. Ledger 'Lore' tab shape: list of {id,title,kind,text,found_in,rarity}. Sim hook requested from A: Sim.get_lore_found() -> Array of ids, Events.lore_found(id).

lore.title: Timetable, torn corner
lore.text: Zero Line, night service. Dep. Platform Zero 00:00. Arr. Last Stop: -- (someone has pencilled beneath) 'when claimed'.

lore.title: Stub: One Way, Mostly
lore.text: ADMIT ONE. Valid: any carriage, any stop. Return: see Lost Property. The rest is a thumbprint, still faintly warm.

lore.title: Note on the bench
lore.text: Whoever sits here: please leave the lamp on. It likes company. It was here before the bench, and the bench was here before me.

lore.title: Station-master memo
lore.text: MEMO to all staff: do NOT call the Zero Line late. It is not late. It is unfinished. Late is a thing trains do when they have somewhere to be.

lore.title: Chalk on a seat back
lore.text: 'I was here at stop 7. I was here at stop 70. I'm still looking for my glove.' Signed with a smiley and a small arrow pointing up.

lore.title: Menu card, Dining car
lore.text: Tonight: soup of the day (it is always today). Pudding of the night. Tea, as ever. Please return cups. Please do not ask where the cups go.

lore.title: Napkin map
lore.text: Drawn in gravy: six boxes in a row, an arrow looping back to the first. Beside the last box: 'ask them what they lost'.

lore.title: Receipt for one umbrella
lore.text: Received: one umbrella, black. Owner: unknown. Reclaimed: not yet. Stored: forever, if need be. Signed, the Attendant (the last one, or the first).

lore.title: Postcard from Brasswater
lore.text: Wish you were here. Wish I was where I was. The rain is polished and the tea is hot. P.S. The train never leaves. It only lets us go.

lore.title: Sleeper car pencil note
lore.text: Dear whoever has bunk four: you snore. It is a lovely sound. It sounds like a train, and I find I miss the real one when it stops.

lore.title: Lullaby, third verse
lore.text: 'Wheels, wheels, count them slow. Every stop's a place to go. Every light's a someone's name. Every name, a lost-and-claimed.' (A child has added a star.)

lore.title: Blanket tag
lore.text: This blanket was knitted for a person who never boarded. It has kept three passengers warm and one conductor honest.

lore.title: Timetable, a different year
lore.text: Zero Line, winter service. 14 stops. No terminus listed. Footnote: 'The terminus is arranged by the passengers.'

lore.title: Graffiti in the Luggage car
lore.text: DON'T WORRY, IT'S ONLY LUGGAGE. (Underneath, in a different hand: 'it was me.')

lore.title: Parcel label, blank
lore.text: To: ______ From: ______ Contents: something somebody couldn't carry. Handle with care. Handle with a lot of care.

lore.title: Porter's ledger page
lore.text: Total parcels aboard: 4,112. Total delivered: 4,111. One parcel is the train. We don't discuss it. We do wave at it.

lore.title: Stub: Standing Room
lore.text: ADMIT ONE to the Observation car. View: everything. Please do not look for the front. It will find you, in its own time.

lore.title: Star chart, annotated
lore.text: A circle of stops, pencilled over and over. In the centre, in tiny letters: 'Lost Property.' Beneath: 'oh. Of course.'

lore.title: Note under the lamp
lore.text: I saw a light at the front. It was steady and warm. It was not a signal. It was a lantern. I think it's been waiting since before the line.

lore.title: Railwayman's diary
lore.text: Day 1: the train does not arrive. Day 40: the train does not arrive. Day 200: the train does not need to. I stay for the company.

lore.title: The small tag
lore.text: A little paper tag on a string: UNCLAIMED. The string is new. The tag is older than the carriage. Someone keeps replacing the string.

lore.title: Scrap: station-master speech
lore.text: 'We shall reach the last stop,' he said, 'the day somebody takes it.' Nobody asked what it was. Everybody understood.

lore.title: Folded ticket, blank
lore.text: Valid for: the last stop. Issued to: you, whenever you're ready. Instruction: keep handing things back, and it will print itself.

lore.title: Final memo, in your handwriting
lore.text: If you're reading this, the train is lighter. Keep the lamp lit. The last stop is a handing-over. You're nearly there. Thank you, attendant.
